items.text: Pittsburgh (Wed practice report, Nov 11; Thu report not yet posted): IR - WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot; practice window not opened, won't return for Wk10 per Yahoo). Limited - DT Derrick Harmon (foot, designated to return from IR, hasn't played since Wk4), S DeShon Elliott (ankle). DNP (rest) - T.J. Watt, Cameron Heyward, TE Darnell Washington. Full - CB Brandin Echols (hamstring), WR Ben Skowronek (calf), DB Doneiko Slaughter (hamstring). Aaron Rodgers starts.

Cincinnati (Wed practice report, Nov 11 - estimated, walkthrough; Thu report not yet posted): IR - DE Cashius Howell (wrist). DNP - S Kyle Dugger (quad, inactive last 2 games), DT Jonathan Allen (rest). Limited - LG Dylan Fairchild (pectoral), CB DJ Turner II (ankle). Joe Burrow starts.
